# shelfie

> The shelfie HTTP API.

Every endpoint below links to its reference page as Markdown. The OpenAPI document is at `/openapi.json` and the interactive reference at `/docs`. Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.

## Authentication

- `bearer` (bearer): Session token from POST /v1/auth/login with "transport": "bearer", or an API key (gbk_…) from POST /v1/auth/api-keys. Browsers use the session cookie that login sets instead.

## Ops: auth

- [List accounts](/docs/ops-auth/ops-list-users.md): `GET /ops/auth/users`
- [Create an account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-create-user.md): `POST /ops/auth/users`
- [Get an account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-get-user.md): `GET /ops/auth/users/{id}`
- [Delete an account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-delete-user.md): `DELETE /ops/auth/users/{id}`
- [Ban an account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-ban-user.md): `POST /ops/auth/users/{id}/ban`
- [Unlink a Google, Apple or GitHub account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-remove-user-identity.md): `DELETE /ops/auth/users/{id}/identities/{identityId}`
- [Start a session as an account (development only)](/docs/ops-auth/ops-impersonate-user.md): `POST /ops/auth/users/{id}/impersonate`
- [Turn on an authenticator app for an account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-enroll-user-totp.md): `POST /ops/auth/users/{id}/mfa/enroll`
- [Reset an account's second factors](/docs/ops-auth/ops-reset-user-mfa.md): `POST /ops/auth/users/{id}/mfa/reset`
- [Remove a passkey from an account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-remove-user-passkey.md): `DELETE /ops/auth/users/{id}/passkeys/{passkeyId}`
- [Grant a platform role](/docs/ops-auth/ops-grant-user-role.md): `POST /ops/auth/users/{id}/roles`
- [Revoke a platform role](/docs/ops-auth/ops-revoke-user-role.md): `DELETE /ops/auth/users/{id}/roles/{role}`
- [End every session of an account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-revoke-user-sessions.md): `DELETE /ops/auth/users/{id}/sessions`
- [End one session of an account](/docs/ops-auth/ops-revoke-user-session.md): `DELETE /ops/auth/users/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}`
- [Lift a ban](/docs/ops-auth/ops-unban-user.md): `POST /ops/auth/users/{id}/unban`
- [Mark an address verified](/docs/ops-auth/ops-verify-user-email.md): `POST /ops/auth/users/{id}/verify-email`

## Ops: service accounts

- [List service accounts](/docs/ops-service-accounts/ops-list-service-accounts.md): `GET /ops/service-accounts`
- [Create a service account](/docs/ops-service-accounts/ops-create-service-account.md): `POST /ops/service-accounts`
- [Get a service account](/docs/ops-service-accounts/ops-get-service-account.md): `GET /ops/service-accounts/{id}`
- [Change a service account](/docs/ops-service-accounts/ops-update-service-account.md): `PATCH /ops/service-accounts/{id}`
- [Delete a service account](/docs/ops-service-accounts/ops-delete-service-account.md): `DELETE /ops/service-accounts/{id}`
- [List a service account's API keys](/docs/ops-service-accounts/ops-list-service-account-keys.md): `GET /ops/service-accounts/{id}/keys`
- [Create an API key for a service account](/docs/ops-service-accounts/ops-create-service-account-key.md): `POST /ops/service-accounts/{id}/keys`
- [Revoke a service account's API key](/docs/ops-service-accounts/ops-revoke-service-account-key.md): `DELETE /ops/service-accounts/{id}/keys/{keyId}`

## Auth

- [List your API keys](/docs/auth/auth-list-api-keys.md): `GET /v1/auth/api-keys`

- [Revoke an API key](/docs/auth/auth-revoke-api-key.md): `DELETE /v1/auth/api-keys/{id}`
- [Apple's return to the API](/docs/auth/auth-apple-callback.md): `POST /v1/auth/apple/callback`
- [Apple's server-to-server notifications](/docs/auth/auth-apple-notifications.md): `POST /v1/auth/apple/notifications`
- [Sign in with an Apple ID token](/docs/auth/auth-apple-token.md): `POST /v1/auth/apple/token`
- [GitHub's return to the API](/docs/auth/auth-github-callback.md): `GET /v1/auth/github/callback`
- [Google's return to the API](/docs/auth/auth-google-callback.md): `GET /v1/auth/google/callback`
- [Sign in with a Google ID token](/docs/auth/auth-google-token.md): `POST /v1/auth/google/token`
- [List linked Google, Apple and GitHub accounts](/docs/auth/auth-list-identities.md): `GET /v1/auth/identities`
- [Link a Google or Apple account](/docs/auth/auth-link-identity.md): `POST /v1/auth/identities`
- [Unlink a Google, Apple or GitHub account](/docs/auth/auth-remove-identity.md): `DELETE /v1/auth/identities/{id}`
- [Sign in](/docs/auth/auth-login.md): `POST /v1/auth/login`
- [Finish signing in with a second factor](/docs/auth/auth-login-mfa.md): `POST /v1/auth/login/mfa`
- [Start a passkey second factor](/docs/auth/auth-login-mfa-passkey.md): `POST /v1/auth/login/mfa/passkey`
- [Sign out this device](/docs/auth/auth-logout.md): `POST /v1/auth/logout`
- [Sign out every device](/docs/auth/auth-logout-all.md): `POST /v1/auth/logout-all`
- [Get the signed-in user](/docs/auth/auth-me.md): `GET /v1/auth/me`
- [Delete the account](/docs/auth/auth-delete-account.md): `DELETE /v1/auth/me`
- [Replace the recovery codes](/docs/auth/auth-regenerate-recovery-codes.md): `POST /v1/auth/mfa/recovery-codes`
- [Start setting up an authenticator app](/docs/auth/auth-start-totp.md): `POST /v1/auth/mfa/totp`
- [Turn off the authenticator app](/docs/auth/auth-disable-totp.md): `DELETE /v1/auth/mfa/totp`
- [Turn on the authenticator app](/docs/auth/auth-confirm-totp.md): `POST /v1/auth/mfa/totp/confirm`
- [List passkeys](/docs/auth/auth-list-passkeys.md): `GET /v1/auth/passkeys`
- [Add a passkey](/docs/auth/auth-create-passkey.md): `POST /v1/auth/passkeys`
- [Sign in with a passkey](/docs/auth/auth-passkey-login.md): `POST /v1/auth/passkeys/login`
- [Start signing in with a passkey](/docs/auth/auth-passkey-login-options.md): `POST /v1/auth/passkeys/login/options`
- [Start adding a passkey](/docs/auth/auth-begin-passkey-registration.md): `POST /v1/auth/passkeys/registration`
- [Confirm a change with a passkey](/docs/auth/auth-begin-passkey-verification.md): `POST /v1/auth/passkeys/verification`
- [Rename a passkey](/docs/auth/auth-rename-passkey.md): `PATCH /v1/auth/passkeys/{id}`
- [Remove a passkey](/docs/auth/auth-remove-passkey.md): `DELETE /v1/auth/passkeys/{id}`
- [Change the password](/docs/auth/auth-change-password.md): `PUT /v1/auth/password`
- [Email a password reset code](/docs/auth/auth-forgot-password.md): `POST /v1/auth/password/forgot`
- [Set a new password with a reset code](/docs/auth/auth-reset-password.md): `POST /v1/auth/password/reset`
- [Create an account](/docs/auth/auth-register.md): `POST /v1/auth/register`
- [List signed-in devices](/docs/auth/auth-list-sessions.md): `GET /v1/auth/sessions`
- [Sign out one device](/docs/auth/auth-revoke-session.md): `DELETE /v1/auth/sessions/{id}`
- [Verify an email address with its code](/docs/auth/auth-verify-email.md): `POST /v1/auth/verify-email`
- [Send a new verification code](/docs/auth/auth-resend-verification.md): `POST /v1/auth/verify-email/resend`
- [Start linking a GitHub account](/docs/auth/auth-start-identity-link.md): `POST /v1/auth/{provider}/link`
- [Get a nonce for a native sign-in](/docs/auth/auth-social-nonce.md): `POST /v1/auth/{provider}/nonce`
- [Sign in with Google, Apple or GitHub in a browser](/docs/auth/auth-start-social.md): `GET /v1/auth/{provider}/start`
